The '''Heat Induction Staff''' was an emergency heat generator made by [[Salasetti Survival Systems, Incorporated]]. Derived from [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] weapons technology, the staff used [[heating laser]]s to excite molecules to generate heat.
